name.value: test of sentence comprehension (ToSC), Slovak version adjusted for fMRI

quotes: a language-specific Slovak version of the test of sentence comprehension (ToSC) adjusted for fMRI

description.value: The ToSC consists of black-and-white pictures depicting an action (the roles of the main participants may reverse and they differ visually from each other, e.g., in the shade of their clothes) and semantically reversible sentences in which the main participants (subjects and objects) can exchange their thematic roles and the sentence still remains meaningful. These syntactically complex sentences contain transitive verbs and two nouns (person/animal), one functioning as a subject and the other as an object, both of which can perform the action expressed by the verb. Participants quietly read the sentence below the picture on the screen during fMRI and their task was to decide whether the sentence matched the scene in the picture by pressing a YES or NO button. The control task used the same picture material with a syntactically simple sentence below the picture. The fMRI task consisted of 96 trials, divided into 2 sessions (48 trials each); during the trial (10 s) a picture was presented with a sentence describing the picture (until the participant responded, up to 5 s), followed by a fixation cross (minimally 5 s).

The sentences were characterized by the condition of canonicity (canonical, non-canonical, and control; 32 trials each). The rate of correct and false statements was 1:1 (48 to 48).

description.value: The fMRI data were preprocessed using the SPM 12 toolbox running under Matlab 2019a (MathWorks, Inc.). Preprocessing included realignment, multiecho merging based on CNR, spatial normalization, and smoothing (5 mm FWHM Gaussian filter). Subjects for whom the framewise displacement metric exceeded 0.5 mm in more than 20% of the scans in each of the sessions were excluded, and data were controlled for spatial abnormalities (e.g., dropouts) with the Mask Explorer tool.
